title: Workflow: Reviews, Refills & Shipping

pairs.ask: Daily Review Sources: Feed And Files Only Or Ask Each Agent For A Line?

optionA.label: Feed And Files
optionA.desc: Coach reads the team feed, handoffs and dashboards, no extra asks.

pairs.ask: New Rules: One Daily Batch Or As Soon As You Say Them?

optionA.label: One Daily Batch
optionA.desc: Rules collect during the day and go out once, with clashes checked.

optionB.label: Right Away
optionB.desc: Each rule goes out as soon as you set it.

pairs.ask: Shelf Refill After Submit: Right Away Or At The Next Watch Run?

optionA.label: Right Away
optionA.desc: The submitted deck is replaced as soon as Coach handles it.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#D4A017"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">REFILL TIMING</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Right Away</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The submitted deck is replaced as soon</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">as Coach handles it.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Next Watch Run
optionB.desc: Refills happen together at the next hourly Submit Watch.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">REFILL TIMING</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Next Watch Run</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Refills happen together at the next</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">hourly Submit Watch.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.desc: Routines list each command so every run is the same.

pairs.ask: Late Night Rule Changes: Hold After 22:00 Or Ship Anytime?

optionA.label: Hold After 22:00
optionA.desc: New dashboard rules after 22:00 wait for the morning, so boards are not redone three times.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#D4A017"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">LATE NIGHT SHIPPING</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Hold After 22:00</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">New dashboard rules after 22:00 wait</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">for the morning, so boards are not</text><text x="18" y="124" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">redone three times.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Ship Anytime
optionB.desc: Rules go out the moment you set them, day or night.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">LATE NIGHT SHIPPING</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Ship Anytime</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Rules go out the moment you set them,</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">day or night.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Unanswered Suggestion Rounds: Leave Open Until Submit Or Fold Into Shelf Decks After 48 Hours?

optionA.label: Leave Open
optionA.desc: Round 2 stays open until you press Submit.

optionB.desc: After 48 hours, open cards move into the Rule Cleanup or Overlap deck.
